# 2 Baruch Chapter 49 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Fourth Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** I answered: "In what form will the people live who are alive in your day? How will the glory of those who come after that time go on?"

**2** "Will they take up their present forms again, with the shackles of evil they now carry — by which all evil is done?"

**3** "Or will you perhaps change these things that have existed in the world, just as the world itself will be changed?"

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
